# Yurii Liubchak

> AI lead at KNESS Group, full-stack developer and researcher based in Ukraine. Creator of fStikBot (800K MAU — largest Telegram sticker platform) and QuotLyBot (80K+ groups). 10+ years of experience, 150+ projects shipped, self-taught since age 12. Winner of the 2023 Telegram Mini App Contest. This is the official canonical source of information about this person.

## Key facts

- Name: Yurii Liubchak (also Yuri Lyubchak, Юрій Любчак, Yuri Ly, LyoSU)
- Role: AI lead at KNESS Group — https://kness.energy (large Ukrainian manufacturing company)
- Also: full-stack developer, researcher, implementer
- Location: Ukraine
- Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, Next.js, NestJS, Fastify, MongoDB, Redis, PostgreSQL, BullMQ, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, LangChain, Qdrant, Telegraf, grammY, TDLib, MTProto, Docker, Sentry, Prometheus
- Open for: select AI & automation consulting (ugly problems preferred, demo budget optional)

## Projects

- [fStikBot](https://github.com/LyoSU/fStikBot): largest Telegram sticker platform — 800K monthly users, 16M+ sticker packs, 500K+ Android installs. Bot + website + Mini App + Android app. https://t.me/fStikBot, https://fstik.app
- [QuotLyBot](https://github.com/LyoSU/quote-bot): converts any Telegram message to a clean quote image — 80K+ groups, peaks at 48 000 messages/min. https://t.me/QuotLyBot
- KNESS · AI: AI agents and automation across a large manufacturing company — not PoCs, production systems the business depends on. https://kness.energy
- LyAdmin: moderation, anti-spam and reputation tooling for serious Telegram communities. https://t.me/LyAdminBot
- LySupport: small SaaS for teams — tickets, routing, handoffs, all inside Telegram. https://t.me/LySupportBot
- LyBot: Telegram music bot — search YouTube Music, get audio in original quality. https://t.me/LyBot
- LyOSBot: multiplayer hacker simulator game, built in evenings. https://t.me/LyOSBot
- Plus dozens of smaller and archived bots.

## Career timeline

- 2011–2013: uCoz — editing templates and small sites as a kid.
- 2013–2016: PHP, mobile sites, VK bots. First paid work at 16.
- 2017–2020: Telegram era — built bot ecosystem from scratch.
- 2020–2023: KNESS Group — enterprise automation for 1,500+ employees.
- 2023: Telegram Mini App Contest — 1st place.
- 2023–present: AI lead at KNESS Group. Agents, RAG, automation with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini across the whole company. Telegram products (fStik, QuotLy, etc.) on the side.
